prompts.question: Is the lead interior architect or studio verified on the Design Institute of Australia (DIA) Accredited Designer register?
prompts.why_it_matters: Holding DIA Accredited Designer standing signifies adherence to professional practice codes, CPD compliance, and rigorous qualification vetting in Australia.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the DIA 'Find a Designer' register on design.org.au by designer name {person} or practice name {company}
prompts.found_when: The studio claims DIA Accredited Designer or Fellow membership status but is absent from the official register
prompts.not_found_when: The practitioner is confirmed as an active DIA Accredited Designer with valid professional standing
prompts.couldnt_check_when: DIA member directory is temporarily unreachable

tested.result: Founding principal and senior team verified as recognized leaders in Australian design bodies
Studio principals hold active professional membership with the Design Institute of Australia
Professional interior architecture credentials independently verified
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Design Institute of Australia (DIA)

prompts.question: Can national interior design awards (such as AIDA Premier Award or Category Winner) showcased in the studio's portfolio be verified in official AIDA archives?
prompts.why_it_matters: Falsely claiming prestigious Australian Interior Design Awards deceives commercial property developers and breaches Australian Consumer Law regarding misleading advertising.
prompts.how_to_query: Query official AIDA winners gallery by year, project name, and studio name {company}
prompts.found_when: The studio showcases an AIDA trophy or shortlist recognition that does not exist in official AIDA archives
prompts.not_found_when: The project title, award category, and winning year match official AIDA competition records
prompts.couldnt_check_when: AIDA awards gallery database is undergoing maintenance

tested.result: Multiple AIDA winning and shortlisted projects verified in official awards gallery
Extensive AIDA residential design awards confirmed in official historical archives
Celebrated residential and commercial interiors verified on AIDA winner rolls
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Australian Interior Design Awards (AIDA)

prompts.question: Does the interior design firm hold an active state builder or trade contractor licence when executing structural, demolition, or residential renovation works over statutory thresholds?
prompts.why_it_matters: Carrying out residential building and renovation work above state thresholds without a valid contractor licence and mandatory home warranty insurance is illegal and leads to heavy statutory fines.

source.name: State Building Regulators (VBA / NSW Fair Trading / QBCC)

prompts.how_to_query: Check state public licence registers (e.g. NSW Fair Trading public register or Victorian Building Authority register) for {company}
prompts.found_when: The firm undertakes physical renovation contracts exceeding state limits without holding the required contractor license
prompts.not_found_when: The firm holds a valid builder licence or engages licensed head building contractors for physical works
prompts.couldnt_check_when: State licensing public register lookup system is offline

tested.result: Operates as design and interior architecture practice engaging licensed registered builders for construction
Residential projects executed in collaboration with licensed NSW residential building contractors
Design specifications carried out by licensed master builders compliant with VBA standards
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for State Building Regulators (VBA / NSW Fair Trading / QBCC)

prompts.question: Do verified homeowner ratings and project completion reviews on major Australian design portals contradict the studio's on-time delivery and fixed-price contract claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: Unresolved consumer complaints regarding defect rectification or budget blowouts on leading trade portals deter high-net-worth residential and commercial design clients.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Houzz Australia professional directory for {company} and review customer ratings and project reviews
prompts.found_when: Verified customer reviews report major cost overruns, unresolved design defects, or abandoned renovation contracts
prompts.not_found_when: The studio maintains a verified 5-star profile with positive homeowner feedback on craftsmanship and delivery
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Houzz directory triggers bot security verification

tested.result: Exemplary client portfolio reviews and industry design acclaim documented
Consistently high verified client feedback for bespoke residential transformations
Prestigious client review standing across architectural and interior publications
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Houzz Australia Design Directory

prompts.question: Does the interior designer unlawfully use the legally protected title 'Architect' or 'Interior Architect' without being registered with a state Architects Registration Board (e.g. NSW ARB, ARBV)?
prompts.why_it_matters: Under state Architects Acts across Australia, using the title 'Architect' without statutory registration is a punishable offense incurring substantial fines.
prompts.how_to_query: Verify practitioner's use of 'Architect' against state registers (e.g. NSW Architects Registration Board or ARBV register)
prompts.found_when: The designer advertises as an 'Architect' or 'Architectural Practice' without statutory registration on the state roll
prompts.not_found_when: The practice accurately uses 'Interior Designer' or lead principals hold valid registration on the state Architects Roll
prompts.couldnt_check_when: State architect registration board register is unreachable

tested.result: Proper professional designation as multidisciplinary design practice compliant with state title rules
Accurate business designation as interior design studio with no unlawful architect claims
Design studio branding strictly complies with Australian professional titling laws
Re-tested round 2: verified active register criteria for Architects Registration Boards Australia
